metadata.title: Structural classification of the Stage13 deviation modes
metadata.scope: finite structural classification; no additive attribution across incomparable diagnostics and no asymptotic claim

G_neutral_to_shell_neutral.type: exact finite reweighting transition isolating primitive-support correction

shell_neutral_to_raw.type: exact finite reweighting transition restoring supported-shell richness

cumulative_raw_to_outer_half_raw.type: boundary/stability comparison; not an additive mechanism

canonical_archimedean_geometry.role: creates a large positive leading-half mode and a positive ac/bc split in the chamber model
canonical_archimedean_geometry.status: exact real-density/chamber model, not the full arithmetic count

pure_G_arithmetic_profile.role: nearly cancels the ac/bc split mode under G-neutral weighting while leaving a large positive leading mode

primitive_support.role: reintroduces a positive ac/bc split and modestly reduces the leading mode

supported_shell_richness.role: dominant finite flattening of the leading-half mode; changes beta only slightly

parity_order_coupling.role: OE and EE raw strata have opposite alpha signs and partially cancel in the aggregate; raw beta is positive in both strata. After pure-G deweighting their ac/bc pair gaps have opposite signs.
parity_order_coupling.standalone_p2_category_bias: zero by coordinate-permutation symmetry before canonical/order coupling

overlap_exact_one_sieve.role: tiny perturbation of both modes at the largest audited cutoff

cutoff_boundary.role: largest outer-half band remains close to cumulative raw modes; no competing boundary-generated deviation is visible

stage12_projection_fiber.role: exact directional null for normalized proportions because every canonical raw incidence has the same projection multiplicity 2
stage12_projection_fiber.status: exact theorem-level finite identity from Stage13-3d

final_exact_one.interpretation: At B=100000 the final exact-one deviation is beta-dominated: the residual visible departure from 2:1:1 lies mainly in the ac/bc split, not in failure of ab to carry one half of the mass.

non_additivity_warning.statement: Do not sum every named mechanism as if they were orthogonal causal contributions. Geometry is a model comparison, OE/EE is a stratification, boundary is a control, and fiber is an exact null. Only explicitly linked normalized reweighting transitions telescope.
non_additivity_warning.exact_telescope_used: (G_neutral -> shell_neutral) + (shell_neutral -> raw) = (G_neutral -> raw) in Delta/alpha/beta coordinates

conclusion.next: Stage13-7: study the B-dependence of alpha(B), beta(B), and Delta(B), and decide whether any limiting or secondary asymptotic law is supported/provable.
